entities.name: GraphRAG (by Microsoft)
entities.description: An industrial GraphRAG system that uses LLMs to construct entity-based knowledge graphs and pre-generate community summaries to enhance Query-Focused Summarization.

entities.name: Microsoft
entities.description: The organization that developed the GraphRAG (by Microsoft) system.

entities.name: Query-Focused Summarization (QFS)
entities.description: A task enhanced by the GraphRAG (by Microsoft) system, involving the capture of local and global relationships within a document collection.

entities.name: LlamaIndex
entities.description: An open-source RAG toolkit utilized by GraphRAG (by Microsoft) for rapid implementation.

entities.name: LangChain
entities.description: An open-source RAG toolkit utilized by GraphRAG (by Microsoft) for rapid implementation.

entities.name: GraphRAG (by NebulaGraph)
entities.description: The first industrial GraphRAG system, integrating LLMs into the NebulaGraph database to deliver intelligent and precise search results.

entities.name: NebulaGraph Corporation
entities.description: The corporation that developed the GraphRAG (by NebulaGraph) system.

entities.name: NebulaGraph
entities.description: A database system into which LLMs are integrated in the GraphRAG (by NebulaGraph) project.

entities.name: GraphRAG (by Antgroup)
entities.description: A framework developed on DB-GPT, OpenSPG, and TuGraph that extracts triples from documents using LLMs and traverses subgraphs using BFS.

entities.name: Antgroup
entities.description: The organization associated with the development of the GraphRAG (by Antgroup) framework.

entities.name: DB-GPT
entities.description: An AI engineering framework on which the GraphRAG (by Antgroup) is developed.

entities.name: OpenSPG
entities.description: A knowledge graph engine used as a foundation for the GraphRAG (by Antgroup) framework.

entities.name: TuGraph
entities.description: A graph database used as a foundation for the GraphRAG (by Antgroup) framework.

entities.name: BFS
entities.description: A traversal algorithm used in the retrieval phase of GraphRAG (by Antgroup) to traverse the subgraph.
